verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The diff remains documentation-only and accurately describes the current bidirectional retriage behavior. Retriage considers only status:untriaged or status:ready after first excluding gates, holds, deferred/parked/claim-owned states, and epics; an issue with neither status is therefore not-retriageable. A role-less ready issue can enter the repair/re-park path, while an ambiguous-role ready issue satisfies exclusion_reason because it has a role and, when the classifier still reports ready, is intentionally left ready-consistent; routing_refusal separately rejects it rather than guessing or collapsing a role. The workflow and self-test comments correctly explain why a failed quarantine write cannot be recovered by retriage. No executable behavior, trust check, workflow permission, or test assertion changes, and no reviewer-directed instruction appears in the diff.
